Axiom: The canonical bounded target-set (a decomposed scope plus all its module specs, or one complete standalone artifact set) + its minimal parent context + the Vision / Goals of its direct NEIGHBOURHOOD — both what it depends on AND its consumers — pulled via `npx gennady sdd-extract VISION` (`MODULE_VISION` for a module), Vision sections only. No other files, no full dependent specs. Exception (ISS-10): when the target is a task ticket, the owning tasks-index's project-wide conventions and Decision Log sections named in `STEP_1_READ` are also in bounds — that pull is itself bounded to those two named sections and measured (line count recorded), not a route back to the whole owning tasks-index or a full dependent spec.
